in_sanskrit.name: Revatī
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: She who is filled with joy and radiance, or She who is enchanted and captivated by the beauty of the world.

in_marathi.name: Revathi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Revathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of the Moon who is also known as Chandra Mata or Revati. Revathi is a name that is filled with grace and beauty. It is a name that inspires a sense of wonder and mystery.
